response.original_title: How do I add a passenger on a Windstar Cruise?
response.overview: To add a passenger to an existing reservation, you must call Windstar Cruises Customer Service directly or contact your travel agent, as additions cannot be made online or through the mobile app.  Steps and Requirements  Call Direct: Reach out to Windstar at 1-855-732-4023 +44-289-708-0062 (UK)(US/Canada) or your original travel agent.  Have Details Ready: Provide your current booking number along with the new passenger’s full legal name and date of birth.  Check Capacity: Adding a guest depends on your stateroom's maximum occupancy limits and overall ship lifeboat safety capacities.  Pricing Updates: Your booking will be re-priced at current, updated rates for the additional guest.  Timing: Make changes well before the final manifest is submitted (typically before final payment or 24–72 hours prior to departure).
